text:
maya: opened PR to update the structured-output docs for the runtime key rename and add a tiny migration note + examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120

felix: nice. pls cover both: current key `structured_output_schema` and the new `structured_schema` (call out which release will flip). Customers will search for both.

ondra: also add a compact envelope vs bare-call example and a 1-line nullable-array shim. keep examples tiny.

maya: draft examples in the PR: bare:
```json
{"name":"translate_text","arguments":{"text":"hi","to":"fr"}}
```

envelope:
```json
{"call":{"name":"translate_text","arguments":{"text":"hi","to":"fr"}},"meta":{"source":"translate-v2"}}
```

ondra: nullable-array shim suggestion:
```js
const hits = Array.isArray(res.hits) ? res.hits : (res.hits ? [res.hits] : []);
```
this normalizes null/single-object to an array.

felix: include a tiny SDK helper (6 lines) showing parse + deterministic error msg for tests. show exact string `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'text'`.

maya: added helper and explicit error string in the PR. Also added guardrail paragraph: prefer tolerating extra fields (`"additionalProperties": true`) for forward compatibility.

eng-runtime-bot: runtime note: current key is `structured_output_schema`. Planned rename to `structured_schema` in release 2025.06. Docs should reference current key and link runtime#782 for the migration timeline.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #5120  lint: running, md-link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

ci-bot: CI results for PR #5120  lint: pass, md-link-check: pass, examples-tests: failed (flaky assertion on error string).

ondra: failing test is the negative path. sometimes runtime error omits quotes around field name. normalize in helper by throwing the exact string used in tests.

maya: updated helper to throw `StructuredParseError: missing required field 'text'` and added a tiny unit test asserting the message. pushed.

ci-bot: rerun CI for PR #5120  examples-tests: pass, all checks: pass.

felix: quick editorial pass: reword guardrail sentence to "tolerate extra fields to allow forward-compatible schema evolution" and add a one-line rationale.

maya: done. requesting final review @felix @ondra.

felix: approved. merging now. :tada: docs site will rebuild on next deploy.

maya: thanks everyone!
